questions.explanation: With 'Look!' we describe what is happening now, so use the present continuous.
With 'they' the present continuous uses 'are' + verb-ing.
With 'I' the present continuous uses 'am' + verb-ing.
'Be quiet!' shows the action is happening now, so use the present continuous.
With 'they' (the birds) use 'are' + verb-ing in the present continuous.
Double the final consonant after a short vowel: run → running.
Drop the -e before -ing: write → writing.
Double the final consonant after a short vowel: swim → swimming.
Yes/no questions in the present continuous start with am/is/are.
Questions in the present continuous use is/are + subject + verb-ing.
Negative present continuous: am/is/are + not + verb-ing.
questions.q: I ___ TV. I'm reading a book.

questions.explanation: For a temporary situation happening now, use the negative present continuous.
Present continuous needs 'is' + verb-ing: 'is cooking'.
options: She cooks dinner now at moment.

questions.explanation: Question word + is/are comes before the subject in present continuous questions.
With 'the dog' (it) use 'is' + verb-ing.
An action happening at this moment uses the present continuous.
With 'my parents' (they) use 'are' + verb-ing.
questions.q: My parents ___ dinner at the moment. (cook)

questions.explanation: 'Have' becomes 'having' in the present continuous.
Weather happening now uses the present continuous: 'is raining'.
With 'they', present continuous questions use 'Are'.
